description: This file defines immutable data models for a user profile system in a skill exchange platform. It includes the User and Skill classes with JSON serialization/deserialization, copyWith methods, and equality operators.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents an application user profile with offered and wanted skills. It is immutable and provides JSON serialization utilities.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: Represents a skill with an optional level, used within the User model to specify skills offered and wanted.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of User or Skill with some fields replaced.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes User or Skill instance into a Map suitable for JSON encoding.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes JSON Map into a User or Skill instance.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Encodes User instance into a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJsonString
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a User instance.
